lines.text: Welcome to Crossroads, little light. Through my gate lies Farm and Fight: a place to farm, hatch eggs, and raise a happy team of pets. They love helping you gather treasure. There are battles too, whenever you feel ready for adventure.
Hello, little light. Ready to meet your new companions? My gate leads to Farm and Fight. There is plenty to grow, plenty to hatch, and no need to hurry.
Give your pets a crystal or a chest to work on, and they will happily gather treasure with you. Hatch more eggs, build your team, and explore at your own pace. I will help you get started.
Oh, there you are! I was cheering on a very hardworking little team. Thank you for waiting, little light. Let me show you the way.
What a lovely place to put your team to work. Let your pets break open the chests, then collect those silver Crossroad Coins. Every little bit helps.
Look at those busy little paws. You are building something lovely together.
A little teamwork, a little treasure, and happy pets. That is a wonderful start.
There might be a new friend waiting in that egg. Have a look at the possibilities, and hatch whenever you are ready.
Oh, welcome to the team, little one! I think you and your new friend will make each other very happy.

Welcome to my side of Crossroads. My gate leads to Pet Siege. Enemy waves, eggs to defend, and your tactical brilliance on public display. Hatch defenders, build your defenses, and try to keep something alive. I do adore an optimist.
Another promising commander. How fortunate that confidence requires no qualifications. Step through my gate for Pet Siege, if you are quite finished admiring it.
Pet Siege is combat. Hatch your defenders, place them wisely, and protect your eggs from wave after wave of enemies. No peaceful afternoon of farming. Do try to remember which side you are defending.
Oh, forgive the wait. Someone in the arena was demonstrating a truly original misunderstanding of strategy. But please, your future mistakes deserve my full attention.
Heading into the arena? Splendid. Voluntary humiliation is always more entertaining. I will be right here, offering absolutely invaluable commentary.
An intriguing strategy: let the pets do all the difficult thinking. Finally, sensible leadership.
Such confidence. Such movement. I am still waiting for the part where those become a plan.
Do carry on. I had no idea an arena fight could contain this much suspense and this little dignity.
One down. Try not to make that your entire career highlight.
You actually won. How inconvenient for my commentary. Enjoy it; I am sure the next opponents will be more considerate.
Leaving already? Naturally. A tactical withdrawal. I would never call it running away while you can still hear me.
